status: recon complete; campaign kicked off from public issue HangGlidersRule/model-forge#14
policy: Quantize from the upstream BF16 weights only. Third-party quantized checkpoints are evidence and serving probes, never build inputs. No abliteration.

license.declared_in: model card metadata (the repo ships no LICENSE file)
license.redistribution: Modified weights may be redistributed. Ship the Apache-2.0 text and mark modified files.

architecture.kind: dense decoder used as a cross-encoder reranker

serving_facts.chat_template: Qwen3-Reranker yes/no judge template (required: without it scores are flat and wrong)
serving_facts.classifier: vLLM builds the score row from the lm_head rows for 'yes' and 'no'; lm_head is tied to embed_tokens, so an unquantized embedding table keeps the classifier BF16 (load_weights_using_from_2_way_softmax, vllm/model_executor/models/adapters.py at v0.32.0).
serving_facts.sequence_unit: one query-document pair per sequence; long requests are many pairs, not one long sequence

prior_art_on_hub: KoliaNik/Qwen3-Reranker-4B-NVFP4 (llm-compressor W4A4, lm_head BF16; eval on 150-query MTEB subsets, docs truncated to 800 chars)
throwerdopey0/Qwen3-Reranker-4B-seq-cls-NVFP4 (llm-compressor W4A4 from a seq-cls conversion, score head BF16)
proposed_product: Darkstar-Qwen3-Reranker-4B-Base-ModelOpt-W4A4-NVFP4 (final id set at publication from the winning candidate)
fallback: FP8 cell if NVFP4 activations fail the reranking gate
